title: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)

title_local.ta: மூவலூர் ராமாமிர்தம் அம்மையார் உயர்கல்வி உறுதித் திட்டம் (புதுமைப் பெண்)
title_local.te: మూవలూరు రామామృతం అమ్మైయార్ ఉన్నత విద్యా భరోసా పథకం (పుదుమై పెన్)
title_local.hi: मूवलूर रामामृतम अम्मैयार उच्च शिक्षा आश्वासन योजना (पुधुमई पेन)

ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Financial grant of Rs. 1,000 per month directly deposited into the bank accounts of female students who studied in government schools from Class 6 to 12 until the completion of their undergraduate degree, diploma, or ITI course.

summary_local.ta: அரசுப் பள்ளிகளில் 6 முதல் 12-ஆம் வகுப்பு வரை பயின்று உயர்கல்வி பயிலும் மாணவிகளுக்கு மாதம் ரூ. 1,000 வங்கி கணக்கில் நேரடியாக செலுத்தப்படுகிறது.
summary_local.te: ప్రభుత్వ పాఠశాలల్లో 6 నుండి 12వ తరగతి వరకు చదివి ఉన్నత విద్యను అభ్యసిస్తున్న విద్యార్థినులకు నెలకు రూ. 1,000 వారి బ్యాంకు ఖాతాల్లో జమ చేయబడుతుంది.
summary_local.hi: कक्षा 6 से 12 तक सरकारी स्कूलों में पढ़ने वाली छात्राओं को उच्च शिक्षा पूरी होने तक प्रति माह ₹1,000 की वित्तीय सहायता दी जाती है।

eligibility.description: Female student must have studied Classes 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu Government schools and be actively enrolled in an accredited higher education college/institute.

benefits.description: Monthly allowance of ₹1,000 credited directly to student's bank account until graduation.

documents_required: School Transfer Certificate (TC) or 6th-12th Study Certificate
Active Bank Account Passbook in student's name
how_to_apply: Apply through the college nodal officer on the official Penkalvi portal (www.penkalvi.tn.gov.in).

title: Tamil Pudhalvan Scheme
ministry: Higher Education & Social Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Monthly financial aid of Rs. 1,000 to boy students who studied in Tamil Nadu government schools from classes 6 to 12 and enter higher education to buy textbooks, stationery, and learning materials.

summary_local.ta: அரசுப் பள்ளிகளில் 6 முதல் 12-ஆம் வகுப்பு வரை படித்து கல்லூரி சேரும் மாணவர்களுக்கு பாடப்புத்தகங்கள், உபகரணங்கள் வாங்க மாதம் ரூ. 1,000 நிதியுதவி.
summary_local.te: ప్రభుత్వ పాఠశాలల్లో 6 నుండి 12వ తరగతి వరకు చదివి కళాశాలలో చేరే విద్యార్థులకు పుస్తకాలు మరియు విద్యా ఖర్చుల కోసం నెలకు రూ. 1,000 సహాయం.
summary_local.hi: सरकारी स्कूलों में 6वीं से 12वीं तक पढ़कर कॉलेज जाने वाले छात्रों को अध्ययन सामग्री हेतु ₹1,000 प्रति माह दिया जाता है।

eligibility.education_level: Undergraduate, Diploma, ITI, Engineering, Arts & Science
eligibility.description: Male students enrolled in undergraduate degree, diploma, or professional courses who completed schooling (Classes 6-12) in Tamil Nadu Government schools.

benefits.description: Direct bank transfer of ₹1,000 every month during course duration.

documents_required: Bank Account details seeded with Aadhaar
how_to_apply: Registration handled online via university/college portal under Tamil Nadu Higher Education portal.

title: Chief Minister's Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam (Farmers' Social Security Scheme)

title_local.te: ముఖ్యమంత్రి ఉళవర్ పాదుకాప్పు తిట్టం (రైతుల విద్య మరియు సంక్షేమ పథకం)
title_local.hi: मुख्यमंत्री उझवर पाथुकाप्पु योजना (किसान परिवार शिक्षा एवं सामाजिक सुरक्षा)

ministry: Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Special comprehensive educational scholarships and social assistance for the children of registered farmers, smallholders, and agricultural laborers in Tamil Nadu from high school through professional degree courses.

summary_local.ta: உழவர் பாதுகாப்புத் திட்டத்தில் பதிவு செய்துள்ள விவசாயிகளின் வாரிசுகளுக்கு 10-ஆம் வகுப்பு முதல் பட்டப்படிப்பு மற்றும் தொழிற்கல்வி வரை கல்வி உதவித்தொகை வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
summary_local.te: నమోదిత రైతులు మరియు వ్యవసాయ కార్మికుల పిల్లలకు 10వ తరగతి నుండి డిగ్రీ, ఇంజనీరింగ్ వరకు విద్యా ఉపకార వేతనాలు అందించబడతాయి.
summary_local.hi: पंजीकृत किसानों एवं खेतिहर मजदूरों के बच्चों को 10वीं कक्षा से लेकर कॉलेज एवं व्यावसायिक डिग्री तक विशेष छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान की जाती है।

eligibility.education_level: Class 10, Class 12, ITI, Polytechnic, UG, PG, Professional (Engg/Medical/Agri)
eligibility.landholding_limit: Small / marginal farmer or landless agricultural laborer
eligibility.description: Parent must possess a valid Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam Identity Card issued by the Tamil Nadu Revenue Department, and the student must be studying in an approved educational institution.

benefits.amount: ₹1,500 to ₹10,000 / year (depending on course level) + marriage/maternity assistance
benefits.description: Annual educational grant for books, hostel, and tuition, plus additional welfare benefits for agricultural families.

documents_required: Parent's Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam (UPT) Card / Member Passbook
how_to_apply: Apply through the Special Tahsildar (Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam) in the Taluk office or via e-Sevai centres.

title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
summary: Central Sector scheme providing income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 to all cultivable landholding farmer families across India.

summary_local.ta: அனைத்து நில உரிமையுள்ள விவசாய குடும்பங்களுக்கும் ஆண்டிற்கு ரூ. 6,000 மூன்று தவணைகளில் (ரூ. 2,000 வீதம்) நேரடியாக வங்கி கணக்கில் வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
summary_local.te: భూమి కలిగిన రైతు కుటుంబాలకు సంవత్సరానికి రూ. 6,000 మూడు విడతల్లో రూ. 2,000 చొప్పున నేరుగా బ్యాంక్ ఖాతాలో జమ చేస్తారు.
summary_local.hi: भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 की वित्तीय सहायता ₹2,000 की तीन समान किस्तों में सीधे बैंक खाते में प्रदान की जाती है।

eligibility.landholding_limit: Cultivable land holding in applicant's or family's name
eligibility.description: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names subject to constitutional and institutional exclusions.

benefits.description: Direct bank transfer into Aadhaar-linked bank account in 3 installments (April-July, August-November, December-March).

documents_required: Land Ownership Documents (Patta / Chitta / Land Record)
how_to_apply: Register on the PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) under Farmer Corner or through local CSC / e-Sevai centres.

title: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students

title_local.ta: கல்லூரி மற்றும் பல்கலைக்கழக மாணவர்களுக்கான மத்திய துறை கல்வி உதவித்தொகை
title_local.te: కళాశాల మరియు విశ్వవిద్యాలయ విద్యార్థుల కోసం సెంట్రల్ సెక్టార్ స్కాలర్‌షిప్ పథకం
title_local.hi: कॉलेज और विश्वविद्यालय के छात्रों के लिए केंद्रीय क्षेत्र छात्रवृत्ति योजना

ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
summary: Financial support to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies in college and universities.

summary_local.ta: குறைந்த வருமானம் கொண்ட குடும்பங்களைச் சேர்ந்த திறமையான மாணவர்கள் உயர்கல்வி தொடர ஆண்டிற்கு ரூ. 12,000 முதல் ரூ. 20,000 வரை உதவித்தொகை.
summary_local.te: తక్కువ ఆదాయం ఉన్న ప్రతిభావంతులైన విద్యార్థులకు కళాశాల చదువుల ఖర్చుల కోసం సంవత్సరానికి రూ. 12,000 నుండి రూ. 20,000 వరకు స్కాలర్‌షిప్.
summary_local.hi: कम आय वर्ग के मेधावी छात्रों को उच्च अध्ययन हेतु ₹12,000 से ₹20,000 प्रति वर्ष की छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान की जाती है।

eligibility.description: Students scoring above 80th percentile in relevant stream in Class 12 board examination and pursuing regular degree courses with family income below Rs. 4.5 Lakhs/year.

benefits.description: Rate of scholarship is ₹12,000 per annum at Graduation level for first 3 years and ₹20,000 per annum at Post-Graduation level.

how_to_apply: Apply online on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).

title: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC / ST / BC / MBC Students

title_local.ta: பிற்படுத்தப்பட்டோர், மிகவும் பிற்படுத்தப்பட்டோர் மற்றும் ஆதிதிராவிடர் பள்ளி இறுதிப் படிப்புக்கு பிந்தைய கல்வி உதவித்தொகை
title_local.te: ఎస్సీ / ఎస్టీ / బీసీ / ఎంబీసీ విద్యార్థుల కోసం పోస్ట్-మెట్రిక్ స్కాలర్‌షిప్ పథకం
title_local.hi: अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति/पिछड़ा वर्ग हेतु पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति योजना

ministry: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare / Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: 100% compulsory non-refundable tuition fee concession and maintenance charges for eligible reserved category students pursuing post-matric courses in accredited colleges.

summary_local.ta: கல்லூரி மற்றும் தொழிற்கல்வி பயிலும் எஸ்சி, எஸ்டி, பிசி, எம்பிசி மாணவர்களுக்கு முழு கல்விக் கட்டண விலக்கு மற்றும் பராமரிப்புப்படி.
summary_local.te: కళాశాలల్లో చదువుతున్న ఎస్సీ, ఎస్టీ, బీసీ, ఎంబీసీ విద్యార్థులకు పూర్తి ఫీజు రీయింబర్స్‌మెంట్ మరియు మెయింటెనెన్స్ అలవెన్స్.
summary_local.hi: आरक्षित वर्ग के उच्च शिक्षण संस्थानों के विद्यार्थियों हेतु संपूर्ण शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति एवं अनुरक्षण भत्ता।

eligibility.description: Student must belong to SC/ST/SCC or BC/MBC community of Tamil Nadu with annual family income within prescribed limits (up to Rs. 2.5 Lakh for SC/ST, Rs. 2.0 Lakh for BC/MBC).

benefits.amount: Full tuition fees covered + ₹4,000 to ₹12,000 / year maintenance
benefits.description: Direct settlement of tuition fees with institution and maintenance allowance deposited into student bank account.

how_to_apply: Apply through college scholarship portal or Tamil Nadu e-Scholarship portal (escholarship.tn.gov.in).

title: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres (ACABC) Scheme

title_local.ta: வேளாண் கிளினிக் மற்றும் வேளாண் வணிக மையங்கள் திட்டம்
title_local.hi: कृषि क्लिनिक और कृषि व्यवसाय केंद्र योजना

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare with NABARD, Government of India
summary: Financial support and up to 44% capital subsidy for agriculture students, graduates, and diploma holders to establish agribusiness enterprises and farm advisory clinics.

summary_local.ta: விவசாய பட்டதாரிகள் மற்றும் மாணவர்கள் சொந்த வேளாண் தொழில் மையம் அமைக்க மானியத்துடன் கூடிய வங்கி கடன் உதவி.
summary_local.te: వ్యవసాయ విద్యార్థులు మరియు పట్టభద్రులు అగ్రి-బిజినెస్ కేంద్రాలను ప్రారంభించడానికి 44% వరకు సబ్సిడీ మరియు రుణ సదుపాయం.
summary_local.hi: कृषि स्नातकों और छात्रों को कृषि क्लीनिक व कृषि उद्यम शुरू करने हेतु 44% तक की पूंजीगत सब्सिडी एवं ऋण सहायता।

eligibility.education_level: Degree or Diploma in Agriculture, Horticulture, Animal Husbandry, Forestry, or Allied Sciences
eligibility.description: Graduates or diploma holders in agriculture or allied subjects from recognized universities, or science graduates with post-graduation in agriculture-related courses.

benefits.amount: Project ceiling up to ₹20 Lakhs (Individual) with 36% to 44% composite subsidy
benefits.description: Bank loan with back-ended capital subsidy: 44% for women, SC/ST, and North-Eastern states; 36% for general category.

documents_required: Degree/Diploma Certificate in Agriculture or Allied Science
how_to_apply: Enroll in free 45-day residential training at MANAGE nodal training institutes, then apply via NABARD bank portal.

title: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam
ministry: Special Initiatives and Social Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Basic monthly income entitlement of Rs. 1,000 provided to eligible women heads of families across Tamil Nadu to recognize unpaid household care work and foster financial autonomy.

summary_local.ta: தகுதியுடைய குடும்பத் தலைவிகளுக்கு மாதந்தோறும் ரூ. 1,000 உரிமைத் தொகை வங்கி கணக்கில் வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
summary_local.te: అర్హులైన మహిళా కుటుంబ పెద్దలకు నెలకు రూ. 1,000 గౌరవ భృతి నేరుగా వారి ఖాతాలో జమ చేయబడుతుంది.
summary_local.hi: योग्य महिला मुखियाओं को ₹1,000 प्रति माह सीधे बैंक खाते में सामाजिक सुरक्षा एवं अधिकारिता हेतु प्रदान किया जाता है।

eligibility.landholding_limit: Less than 5 acres of wetland or 10 acres of dryland
eligibility.description: Woman must be registered as head of family in the Smart Ration Card with family annual income less than Rs. 2.5 Lakhs and electricity consumption under 3,600 units/year.

benefits.description: ₹1,000 deposited on the 15th of every month into beneficiary's bank account.

documents_required: Bank Account details linked to Aadhaar
how_to_apply: Registration via special camps conducted by Revenue Department at ration shop level.

title: PM YASASVI Scholarship Scheme

title_local.ta: பிரதம மந்திரி யசஸ்வி கல்வி உதவித்தொகை திட்டம்

ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
summary: Top class education scholarship for OBC, EBC, and DNT students studying in Class 9 to Class 12 in top identified schools across India.

summary_local.ta: ஓபிசி, இபிசி மற்றும் டிஎன்டி மாணவர்களுக்கு 9 முதல் 12-ஆம் வகுப்பு வரை ஆண்டுக்கு ரூ. 75,000 முதல் ரூ. 1,25,000 வரை உதவித்தொகை.
summary_local.te: ఓబీసీ, ఈబీసీ విద్యార్థులకు 9వ నుండి 12వ తరగతి చదువుల కోసం సంవత్సరానికి రూ. 75,000 నుండి రూ. 1,25,000 వరకు స్కాలర్‌షిప్.
summary_local.hi: ओबीसी, ईबीसी और विमुक्त जातियों के कक्षा 9वीं से 12वीं के छात्रों को ₹75,000 से ₹1,25,000 प्रति वर्ष की छात्रवृत्ति।

eligibility.description: Students belonging to OBC/EBC/DNT categories studying in designated top-class schools with annual parent income not exceeding Rs. 2.5 Lakhs.

benefits.description: Covers school tuition fees, hostel fees, and other books/stationery charges.

how_to_apply: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or PM YASASVI portal.

title: Free Laptop Distribution Scheme for Students

title_local.hi: विद्यार्थियों के लिए निःशुल्क लैपटॉप वितरण योजना

ministry: Special Programme Implementation Department & School Education, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Distribution of free laptops to students studying in government and government-aided higher secondary schools and arts/science/engineering colleges to bridge the digital divide.

summary_local.ta: அரசு மற்றும் அரசு உதவிபெறும் பள்ளி, கல்லூரி மாணவர்களுக்கு கணினி திறனை மேம்படுத்த விலையில்லா மடிக்கணினி வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
summary_local.te: ప్రభుత్వ మరియు ఎయిడెడ్ పాఠశాలలు మరియు కళాశాలల విద్యార్థులకు ఉచితంగా ల్యాప్‌టాప్‌లు అందించబడతాయి.
summary_local.hi: सरकारी एवं सहायता प्राप्त विद्यालयों व महाविद्यालयों के छात्र-छात्राओं को डिजिटल रूप से सक्षम बनाने हेतु निःशुल्क लैपटॉप वितरण।

eligibility.description: Students studying in Tamil Nadu Government and Government-aided schools (Class 12) or polytechnic/arts/science colleges.

benefits.amount: Brand new laptop with pre-installed educational software
benefits.description: One laptop with warranty and essential digital tools distributed directly at the educational institution.

how_to_apply: No individual application required; schools and colleges submit verified beneficiary rosters directly to ELCOT and Education Dept.

title: Naan Mudhalvan Scheme (Skill Enhancement & Career Placement)

title_local.ta: நான் முதல்வன் திட்டம் (திறன் மேம்பாடு மற்றும் வேலைவாய்ப்பு வழிகாட்டி)
title_local.te: నాన్ ముదల్వన్ పథకం (నైపుణ్యాభివృద్ధి మరియు ఉద్యోగ మార్గదర్శకత్వం)
title_local.hi: नान मुधलवन योजना (कौशल विकास एवं रोजगार मार्गदर्शन)

ministry: Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation (TNSDC), Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Flagship skilling initiative training 10 lakh college students annually in emerging technologies (AI, Robotics, Data Analytics, Cloud Computing) with industry-recognized certifications and campus placements.

summary_local.ta: கல்லூரி மாணவர்களுக்கு அதிநவீன தொழில்நுட்ப பயிற்சிகள் வழங்கி வேலைவாய்ப்புகளை உருவாக்க ஆண்டுக்கு 10 லட்சம் மாணவர்களுக்கு திறன் பயிற்சி.
summary_local.te: కళాశాల విద్యార్థులకు ఆధునిక సాంకేతికతలలో ఉచిత నైపుణ్య శిక్షణ మరియు ప్రాంగణ నియామకాలు అందించే కార్యక్రమం.
summary_local.hi: कॉलेज छात्रों को आधुनिक तकनीक जैसे एआई और क्लाउड कंप्यूटिंग में निःशुल्क कौशल प्रशिक्षण व रोजगार के अवसर प्रदान करना।

eligibility.education_level: Engineering, Arts & Science, Polytechnic, ITI students
eligibility.description: Any student enrolled in higher education institutions (Engineering, Arts & Science, Polytechnic) in Tamil Nadu.

benefits.description: Free access to global certifications from Microsoft, Cambridge, Google, and IBM, plus placement drives.

how_to_apply: Register via the Naan Mudhalvan portal (naanmudhalvan.tn.gov.in) with college credentials.

title: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
ministry: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Cashless hospitalization coverage of up to Rs. 5 Lakhs per family per year for recognized medical procedures and surgeries across empanelled government and private hospitals in Tamil Nadu.

summary_local.ta: தகுதியான குடும்பங்களுக்கு ஆண்டுக்கு ரூ. 5 லட்சம் வரை அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்ட அரசு மற்றும் தனியார் மருத்துவமனைகளில் பணமில்லா சிகிச்சை.
summary_local.te: అర్హత కలిగిన కుటుంబాలకు సంవత్సరానికి రూ. 5 లక్షల వరకు ప్రభుత్వ మరియు ప్రైవేట్ ఆసుపత్రులలో ఉచిత నగదు రహిత చికిత్స.
summary_local.hi: योग्य परिवारों को सूचीबद्ध अस्पतालों में गंभीर बीमारियों हेतु प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस इलाज उपलब्ध कराया जाता है।

eligibility.description: Resident family of Tamil Nadu having annual family income less than Rs. 1,20,000 as endorsed by Village Administrative Officer (VAO) or holding eligible ration card.

benefits.description: Cashless in-patient care covering over 1,500 specific medical treatments, cancer care, and diagnostic procedures.

documents_required: Income Certificate from VAO / Tahsildar (< Rs. 1.2 Lakhs)
Aadhaar Cards of all family members
how_to_apply: Enroll at the District Kiosk inside the District Collectorate with ration card and Aadhaar.

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

title_local.ta: ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் - பிரதம மந்திரி மக்கள் ஆரோக்கிய திட்டம்
title_local.te: ఆయుష్మాన్ భారత్ - ప్రధాన మంత్రి జన్ ఆరోగ్య యోజన
title_local.hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (पीएम-जय)

ministry: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
summary: World's largest health assurance scheme providing a health cover of Rs. 5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families.

summary_local.ta: ஏழை மற்றும் எளிய குடும்பங்களுக்கு இரண்டாம் மற்றும் மூன்றாம் நிலை சிகிச்சைகளுக்காக ஆண்டுக்கு ரூ. 5 லட்சம் மருத்துவக் காப்பீடு.
summary_local.te: పేద కుటుంబాలకు ద్వితీయ మరియు తృతీయ స్థాయి ఆసుపత్రి చికిత్సల కోసం సంవత్సరానికి రూ. 5 లక్షల ఉచిత ఆరోగ్య రక్షణ.
summary_local.hi: गरीब और कमजोर परिवारों को माध्यमिक और तृतीयक देखभाल हेतु प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख का स्वास्थ्य सुरक्षा कवर।

eligibility.description: Deprived and occupational categories identified under the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) and all senior citizens aged 70+ irrespective of income.

benefits.description: Covers all pre-existing conditions from Day 1, hospitalization expenses, diagnostics, medicines, and ICU charges.

how_to_apply: Check eligibility online at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or visit any Common Service Centre (CSC) to generate the Ayushman Card.

title: Rythu Bharosa / Rythu Bandhu Scheme
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of Telangana
summary: Agricultural investment support scheme providing direct financial assistance of Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 15,000 per acre per year to land-owning farmers in Telangana to buy seeds, fertilizers, and farming inputs.

summary_local.ta: தெலங்கானா விவசாயிகளுக்கு உழவு செலவுகள், விதைகள், உரங்கள் வாங்க ஏக்கருக்கு ஆண்டுக்கு ரூ. 10,000 முதல் ரூ. 15,000 வரை நேரடி நிதியுதவி.
summary_local.te: రైతులకు విత్తనాలు, ఎరువులు మరియు వ్యవసాయ ఖర్చుల కొరకు ఎకరాకు సంవత్సరానికి రూ. 10,000 నుండి రూ. 15,000 వరకు పెట్టుబడి సహాయం.
summary_local.hi: तेलंगाना के किसानों को बीज, खाद व कीटनाशक खरीदने हेतु ₹10,000 से ₹15,000 प्रति एकड़ प्रति वर्ष की निवेश सहायता।

eligibility.description: All resident farmers possessing verified agricultural land patta passbook in Telangana state.

benefits.frequency: Twice a year (Kharif and Rabi seasons)
benefits.description: Direct bank transfer credited before sowing seasons per acre.

how_to_apply: Automatic enrollment based on Dharani land records or through the Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO).
